_section_pos_encoder: Fourier Positional Encoder (applied before condition MLP)
_section_loss: Loss Weighting (training only; standard MSE if: key omitted, set to null, or method='none')
_loss_weighting: Off deliberately. 'rt60_binary' zeroes the loss for every frame after the RIR has faded by db_threshold, so the model gets no gradient from the tail — the same thing --apply-zero-tail does to the signal, which we stopped doing so the tail would be learned rather than deleted.

Worth trying once a no-mask baseline exists. Its cutoff is rt60 * |db_threshold| / 60, which assumes a straight decay and reads the stored rt60; since every fit window under-reads by 10-30%, the cutoff lands earlier than the threshold implies.
_Note: Every top-level key starting with '_' is for documentation purposes and is not used in the code.
_image_size: Matterport3D is rendered at 224x294, giving a 16x21 = 336-patch grid per image. With 5 images per sample that is 1680 cross-attention tokens. If VRAM is tight, set spatial_pool_factor to 2 rather than shrinking image_size, so the backbone still runs at the rendered resolution.
